Method of Attack: Automatically executes on infected Android devices without user interaction
Distributed via SMS text containing shortened URL to APK installation file
Uses Unicode strings to disguise malicious APKs as legitimate software (Chrome browser)
Tricks users into granting risky permissions including SMS access and background running
Requests to be set as default SMS app to facilitate phishing and spreading
Creates notification channels for custom phishing attacks using Pinterest-hosted messages and URLs
Executes commands from C2 server via WebSocket protocol including exfiltration of photos, SMS, contacts, device identifiers, sending SMS, and HTTP requests
Attack Vector: SMS text messages with shortened URLs to malicious APKs
Indicators of Compromise: Shortened URLs in SMS messages delivering APK files
Malicious APK disguised as Chrome browser
Phishing messages and landing URLs extracted from Pinterest profiles
Commands received via WebSocket from C2 server
